title: 36e8 Cinema Wall Unit
subtitle: The TV wall unit that transforms the space into an immersive experience
description:
Born from the idea of a shift in perspective, the 36e8 Cinema designer TV wall unit is an evolution of the 36e8 Wall Unit, conceived to redefine the living area with a contemporary approach. Positioned in front of the modular volumes, the television becomes the focal point of the composition: it interacts with the system’s geometries and integrates seamlessly into the architectural language of the furniture. The result is a wall unit in which technology and design merge in an unprecedented formal balance.

The module behind the television features an integrated lighting system that enhances the screen’s visual presence, amplifying its perceived depth and elevating the viewing experience. 

A distinctive feature of the project is its integration with LAGO Invisible Sound, a high-quality audio system that plays television sound or music – by connecting to a smartphone – directly through the furniture, transforming it into an acoustic device.

blocks.title: LAGO Invisible Sound: sound integrated into the furniture
blocks.text: Developed in collaboration with a specialist partner, LAGO Invisible Sound integrates a 160-watt audio system into the wall unit, delivering an enveloping and immersive sound experience without compromising the clean lines of the design. Fully integrated into the furniture, the system connects to the television and various devices, such as smartphones and other gadgets, to play music and audio content directly from your mobile. Invisible Sound disappears from view, thereby transforming the furniture into a true audio system, where design, image and sound converge into a single experience.

blocks.title: Architecture, design and technology
blocks.text: The television breaks free from its traditional position on the wall and is positioned in front of the units in the arrangement, becoming an integral part of the interior design scheme. This new perspective redefines the role of the wall unit, transforming it into an architectural feature capable of lending rhythm, depth and personality to the living area.

blocks.title: Compositional flexibility
blocks.text: 36e8 Cinema is suitable for televisions ranging from 55 to 85 inches and offers a high degree of design freedom when configuring the wall unit. The screen can be positioned to project outwards or integrated into the unit, creating different designs thanks to the modular nature of the storage units.

title: Air Roundy Bookshelf
subtitle: The iconic lightness of Air evolves through the freedom of the curve
description:
The Air Roundy Bookshelf evolves from the iconic Air design, which for twenty years has redefined the concept of storage and display through a language of lightness, transparency, and visual reduction. In this new interpretation, the structure remains true to its essence: shelves appear to float in space, supported by glass in a refined balance between solids and voids.

What changes is the design gesture: Air Roundy introduces the curve as a new compositional possibility, giving rise to dynamic and highly customizable configurations. Curves with different radii make it possible to create more or less enveloping solutions, capable of following walls, defining corners, and adapting precisely to the architecture of the space. Sinuous elements and linear modules interact in hybrid compositions, where Air’s iconic lightness remains intact while the form evolves toward a new expressive freedom.

blocks.title: A fluid architectural design for the space
blocks.text: A new freedom of design emerges thanks to curved elements with varying radii, designed to create compositions of different sizes and configurations. The curve becomes an architectural tool capable of transforming the way the bookcase interacts with the space. The sinuous lines follow the contours of the walls, define corners, create unexpected movements and enable a more personalised design.

blocks.title: Twenty years of iconic lightness
blocks.text: Twenty years ago, the Air bookcase introduced a radical idea: to lighten the structure, reduce its visual weight and give the space a sense of breathing room. The suspended shelves, supported by glass brackets, redefined the traditional image of the bookcase, transforming it into an icon of contemporary design. Air Roundy celebrates this legacy by taking the system in a new direction in terms of form. Lightness remains its defining feature, whilst the shape becomes softer and more enveloping, opening up new possibilities for designing spaces, both domestic and commercial.

title: Colletto Bed

description:
With the Colletto bed, you sleep enclosed within a soft visual and sound barrier. A soft-foam ring around the mattress creates a relaxing atmosphere where you can escape from the everyday routine. The ring is attached to the bedframe with velcro and its cover can be removed. There are three bed sizes to choose from: single, double and three-quarter.

The bed’s “collar” can be rolled up or down like a turtleneck, creating three different options: open, semi-closed or completely closed, for a more intimate space. The Colletto bed can be paired with Colletto bedside tables to create an even more harmonious and original look.

title: Fluttua Bed
subtitle: Dreamy floating bed
description:
Fluttua is the world’s first floating bed, defying gravity and offering you an exhilarating sleep experience, floating on air. The frame is held up by a single, central, height-adjustable support, which is fastened to the wall with a carefully designed mechanism. The innovative HPL bed base is imperceptible to the eye, creating a magical floating effect. There’s no barrier beyond the mattress, no solid obstacle restricting the flow of the space in the room. This also makes it easy to clean and keep hygienic.

Thanks to its carefully studied engineering, the bed can be mounted on different types of wall and plasterboard. Rigorous testing ensures the highest safety standards while you sleep.

subtitle: A suspended single bed for the children’s room
description: The Fluttua single bed makes sleeping in the clouds a dream come true. Supported by a single leg, the height of which can be adjusted, it eliminates the superfluous, bringing the bedroom all of the wonder of a bed that seems to be floating magically in the air. With no bulk outside the mattress and no obstacles limiting the space, the design helps keep things clean and tidy. Thanks to its rigorous engineering, the bed can be installed on various kinds of wall and plasterboard, and strict testing ensures absolute safety for the sleeper.

blocks.title: Essential and safe

If equipped, Gizmo can also be transformed into a single container bed, an ideal space-saving solution when you need to furnish small rooms.

subtitle: Modern shelving for the living room
subtitle_card: Striking glass paneling with infinite textures

blocks.title: A wide range of materials

title: Happening Armchair
subtitle: An expression of ease, comfort and total freedom
subtitle_card: An expression of ease, comfort and total freedom
description:
Born from the sofa family, Happening is a collection of comfortable, enveloping armchairs that skilfully recall the aesthetic signs of the past and blend them into contemporary interpretations. Generous and comfortable upholstery deviates from rigid and stiff atmospheres, expressing itself in elegant armchairs, with or without armrests, that rest on the floor.

Creative compositions that, thanks to their personality, are ideal to enrich with original shapes and colours both domestic spaces and environments dedicated to the hospitality world, such as suites and hotel lobbies.

blocks.title: Generous padding
blocks.text: A selected, certified goose-down lining is what gives this sofa its ultra-soft and inviting feel. A combination of sumptuous materials gives a sense of importance to the seats and backrests, morphing into a carefree expression of daily rest & relaxation.

blocks.title: More shape, more comfort, for every eventuality
blocks.text: Three armchair models, with or without armrests, ideal for both residential and hospitality spaces such as suites and lounge areas.

title: Happening Sofa
subtitle: Instant, generous comfort
subtitle_card: Kick back and enjoy a social experience
description:
The name says it all: Happening has a generous spirit, and is open and exuberant. It takes traces of the past and fuses them with contemporary designs, in response to today’s need to kick back and live our homes to the full. A comfy sofa that moves away from rigid paradigms to invite you in and give a sense of immediate comfort. Tailored accents in both the linear and dotted-effect patterns give the surfaces their identity. These details emphasise the soft composure of the upholstery work.

Happening allows you to create different elements that can be combined together: linear sofas, side sofas, trapezoid sofas and chaise longue units. Three different models of the Happening armchair that echo the same shapes and sizes complete the collection.

blocks.title: Versatile designs
blocks.text: The seats and backrests merge into one in a uniquely versatile design: Happening is free of any formal constraints and unfolds in the form of linear sofas, side sofas, chaise units, trapezoidal units, chaise longues and armchairs.

blocks.title: Tailored accents and dotted effects
blocks.text: Carefully placed tucks and stitches give the surfaces their identity, emphasising the soft composure of the upholstery work.

blocks.title: An ultra-soft and inviting feel
blocks.text: A selected, certified goose-down lining is what gives this sofa its ultra-soft and inviting feel. A combination of sumptuous materials gives a sense of importance to the seats and backrests, morphing into a carefree expression of daily rest & relaxation.

title: Hero Sofa
subtitle: Designer sofa with soft forms and a cosmopolitan feel
description: Hero boasts radical geometric armrests and backrests that surround the seats. Interlocking forms that jostle and jut out make for a sophisticated sofa design with soft lines. Refined sartorial upholstery with dexterous quilting creates a sense of rhythm and movement across the interior surfaces. To finish, an elegant play on light-and-dark effects shakes up the design, for a dynamic look. Thanks to its modular mould, the Hero seating design can be used to create countless compositions with real character.

blocks.title: Artisanal quality
blocks.text: Artisanal-quality upholstery work creates a sense of rhythm and movement on the surfaces of the seat. Light-and-dark effects are used elegantly to shake up the sofa design, for a dynamic finish.

blocks.title: Versatile designs
blocks.text: The Hero collection allows you to freely design a range of solutions: linear, corner sofas with chaise longue, ideal for living rooms with character.

title: Hoa Table
subtitle: A modern dining table, free from any rigid rules
description: Free from any rigid pre-defined rules, the modern dining table Hoa offers soft lines for its delicately shaped tops inspired by nature, which stand on solid legs moulded into elliptical and cylindrical forms. The supports can be arranged differently to suit different top sizes and shapes, in an effort to seek out a harmonious form.

blocks.title: Peace and harmony in the dining room
blocks.text: With its soft shapes, the Hoa table blends harmoniously into the dining room space, creating a cosy, convivial atmosphere.

blocks.title: Super stable structures
blocks.text: The arrangement of the supports changes according to the size and shape of the top, ensuring the structure is always fully stable.

title: Hom Bedside Tables
subtitle: A wall-mounted bedside table with transparent open compartments
description: Sleek and simple in its wall-mounted floating design, this unit boasts added elegance in the form of a glass open compartment for storing away your trinkets, perfectly built with a 45° finish. The Hom bedside table can also be fitted with lighting to emphasise the see-through effect and create a warm, inviting feel in the bedroom.

blocks.title: Elegance you can see
blocks.text: The Hom wall-mounted bedside tables feature see-through glass display cases with a smoked finish. Thanks to built-in lighting, they create an evocative look for your bedroom.

seo_title: Floating Nightstand Wall Mounted: Hom Bedside Tables | LAGO

title: Huggy Armchair
subtitle: Convertible chair-cum-bed
description:
Huggy is an armchair bed perfect for welcoming unexpected guests.
A mattress wrapped into a cone shape and inserted into a small cylindrical base to form an armchair bed with soft armrests. Slipping off the base, the mattress automatically unrolls, becoming a comfortable emergency bed. You can also turn the base over to create a practical bedside table.

blocks.title: Transformable décor
blocks.text: Huggy is two products in one, designed to transform from an armchair-bed to an extra bed for guests, with a simple touch.

blocks.title: Artisanal care
blocks.text: The Patchwork fabric is crafted with artisanal care: each piece is unique, made using recycled materials that are sewn by hand, one by one.

seo_title: Convertible Sleeper Chair Bed: Huggy Armchair | LAGO

title: Janeiro Table
subtitle: The ideal combination of solidity and lightness.
description: The lines of a rocky monolith inspired the design of Janeiro table. The characteristic shape of the concrete block that is the base copies the well-known Sugarloaf Mountain in Rio de Janeiro. The base of the table in fact plays with two solid dome shapes in perfect equilibrium, with the table top seeming to balance magically on the summit. The candid textured finish of the concrete works perfectly with the soft lines of the base and the top, available in a circular, oval or rectangular shape.

blocks.title: Technology and design
blocks.text: The unique, innovate shape of the concrete base conceals a structural steel element that joins it to the top.

blocks.title: Endless materials
blocks.text: The table top is available in clear glass, smoky grey glass, polished and matt glass, XGlass or wood, for a truly unique surprising texture contrast.

blocks.title: Surprising contrasts
blocks.text: The transparent perfection of the glass top meets the solidness of the concrete base with its natural anthracite finish to create an extremely contemporary object.

seo_title: Janeiro Table: Sculpted Concrete & Balanced Top | LAGO Design

title: Kera Basin
subtitle: Ceramic washbasin with rounded forms
subtitle_card: An innovative solution with a sophisticated design
description: The ceramic Kera washbasin is innovative and ultra-practical, thanks to its rounded shape and matt enamelled finish. title: Not Only White Sofa
subtitle: The modular sofa made to measure for your space
subtitle_card: To be dressed as you like
description:
Distinguished by bands of different widths that entirely envelop the structure, the sofa leaves room for infinite colour and material combinations thanks to the combination of different colours and fabrics. Not Only White lends itself to various types of stylistic interpretation: a sofa to be dressed in one's own image and likeness, designed to be a unique expression of each style, being configurable in an exclusive way, like a made-to-measure suit.

Designed to offer maximum relaxation, the Not Only White modular sofa stands out for its soft shapes and deep, welcoming seat. A modular product in the sizes and colour moods proposed, capable of adapting flexibly to contemporary spaces and needs, for a tailor-made experience of comfort and design.

blocks.title: Tailoring customisation
blocks.text: The Not Only White sofa can be uniquely configured - just like a made-to-measure suit - in vertical strips or by individually differentiating backrests and seats. Its maximum design freedom allows you to choose both from the colour moods proposed by LAGO and from the wide range of colours, fabrics and textures of the entire collection. Thanks to its tailored design, it is possible to create compositions in the same shade but with different fabric textures for an even more sophisticated effect.

blocks.title: Rhythm of upholstered bands

blocks.title: Maximum comfort and cosiness

subtitle: The designer chair with enveloping lines
description: Fluid lines and enveloping curves give life to a chair that surprises not only with its design, but also with the lightness of the seat resting on its conical base. Proposed in multiple variants, the Novice design chair represents a contemporary solution with sophisticated aesthetics, which can be fully upholstered and removable or in wood for an even more refined effect. blocks.title: Sculptural and sophisticated design

LAGO is constantly experimenting with new ways of engineering its products, finding elegant solutions to elevate its designs, for wall-mounted kitchens and raised islands that resolve and simplify installation, and ensure reliability.

You can customise the individual glass inserts on the N.O.W. tall and wall units in an infinite combination of colours to create a dynamic kitchen design.

blocks.title: Unique materials
blocks.text: LAGO’s development strategy is oriented towards offering innovative materials with real design value, which has led to alternative, unconventional solutions. This translates into tools for interior designers that are highly practical but also capable of stimulating creativity and new ideas, as well as into high-performing materials that last, increasing product durability and reducing the impact on the environment.

title: Vele Bed
subtitle: Have everything to hand with an accessorizable headboard
description: Three staggered panels upholstered in fabric or leather provide extra surface space and help to keep everything within easy reach. The Vele bed with a headboard you can accessorize creates movement in the bedroom interiors. This gives the space a sense of levity, thanks to LAGO’s iconic glass supports.

blocks.title: Accessorizable headboard
blocks.text: The shelves hidden in the headboard are perfect for storing objects and are easy to reach, even in the dark.

blocks.title: Three panels create different depths
blocks.text: The three panels covered in fabric or leather are misaligned as if they were a theatrical scenery. The misalignment creates movement and depth.

blocks.title: Suspension on tempered glass
blocks.text: The mattress, resting on a recessed platform, is suspended on glass legs that make the Vele bed light and contrast with the physicality of the three headboard panels.

blocks.title: Also freestanding
blocks.text: The bed base suspended on glass and the headboard, also finished on the back, are self-standing and no wall-mounting is necessary.

title: Vista Walk-In-Closet
subtitle: Reorganize everyday space like in a boutique

description: Vista is an innovative walk-in closet wardrobe for boutique-style organization of everyday space. The structure has been replaced by solid poles, wooden or glass shelves and drawers that seem to float weightlessly in an unrestricted space. Every element is adjustable in height for total freedom of composition and function. A modular walk-in closet wardrobe that becomes an element of self-expression.

blocks.title: Continuous volumes

blocks.title: Customization of materials

title: Wadi Table
subtitle: An elegant, sculptural table
subtitle_card: A clean cut divides the elliptical base in two
description: A clean cut divides the elliptical base of the elegant Wadi table into two sections, creating a striking, dynamic design. The metal base contrasts with the light, slender top, available in three shapes and different materials: from Wildwood to glass and the luxury XGlass finishes in marble, metal, wood and fabric. Wadi offers captivating structural rigour with a contemporary, architectural stamp.

blocks.title: An unusual sculptural base
blocks.text: The wooden base, lacquered in Titanio Steel, Peltro Steel or Nero, is marked by a bold diagonal cut that guides the gaze towards a new perspective.

blocks.title: Free forms

blocks.title: Unique textured touches

blocks.title: Ergonomics and comfort

title: Y Centerpiece
subtitle: An elegant glass furnishing accessory
description: Y is a light and versatile piece of furniture that can be used in many ways: as a centerpiece, fruit bowl, or simple decorative element. Its essential shape is the result of two 8 mm smoked bronze glass sheets joined together with a precision geometric joint and invisible UV bonding to ensure maximum cleanliness of detail. The LAGO brand name is engraved directly onto the glass using a high-precision process that ensures sharpness and durability. An object that supports without weighing down, capable of integrating elegantly into any home environment, bringing lightness and refinement to spaces.

blocks.title: Magical joints
blocks.text: The two sheets of 8 mm bronze smoked glass are joined through a precision geometric joint that ensures their perfect alignment, while the invisible UV bonding creates a continuous and imperceptible joint. The result is a clear, rigorous sign, devoid of visual interruptions, which enhances the purity of the volume while guaranteeing structural solidity and clean detailing.

blocks.title: Quality in detail
blocks.text: The LAGO mark is obtained by direct engraving on glass, carried out with a high-precision process that intervenes on the material without surface applications. This technique ensures absolute sharpness, resistance to wear and tear and inalterability over time, while maintaining aesthetic quality even after prolonged use.

seo_title: Glass centrepiece Y | LAGO Design
